description: OpenAI image generation MCP server for Model Context Protocol hosts
name: io.github.mindstone/mcp-server-openai-image

environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key with image generation access
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Workspace directory for saving generated images
environmentVariables.name: MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Override the default OpenAI image model identifier
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Outbound HTTP request timeout in milliseconds (max 1800000)
environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: JSON array of absolute paths the connector may read through (and write generated images through) in-workspace symlinks that resolve into them. Mirrors the host's built-in file-tool declared-Space roots. Malformed or partially-malformed values fail closed to workspace-only. Optional; standalone users omit it.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_SYMLINK_ROOTS

title: OpenAI Image
